functions.old_api: named old-api in koldstart.pkl, which also renames it and its logs in lambda
provider.environment.FROM_FILE: ${file(./config.json):key}: there is no ./config.json next to serverless.yml
functions.reports: python3.9 is deprecated or old on lambda: it runs on python3.12 now
functions.image: a prebuilt image or one without a path to build it from: koldstart builds images from a dockerfile; set image { dockerfile; context }
functions.worker.handler: a go function's handler is the package to build, such as ./cmd/worker
functions.worker.layers: a go function has no layers: build what they hold into the binary
functions.old_api: nodejs18.x is deprecated on lambda: it runs on nodejs22.x now
resources.Resources.Files.DeletionPolicy: Snapshot has no equivalent: the resource is retained
resources.Resources.Files.DependsOn: DependsOn has no equivalent: koldstart orders resources by their refs
resources.Resources.Seeder: Custom::Seed is not an aws type cloud control creates
resources.Outputs.FilesArn.Export: exports have no equivalent: other apps read outputs with kdst.stageOutput()
